rationale_short: PowerFlow matches a self-derived alpha-power distribution of the base model; appears only in F1 prose / forest tree.
Multi-Reward RLIF combines voting with self-certainty under KL-Cov regularization; appears only in F2 prose / forest tree.
SePT re-samples its own reasoning traces and online-SFTs on them; appears only in F3 prose.
PonderTTT adapts compute allocation for code generation via within-sequence test-time training.
TT-VLA performs on-the-fly VLA adaptation via test-time RL on the incoming target stream.
SECL self-calibrates via test-time discriminative distillation on the streaming target.
